evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `sat_vb` argument handling to `getmempoolinfo`, `getnetworkinfo`, `estimatesmartfee`, and `estimaterawfee`.
rationale: Resolves a long-standing gap that forces downstream tooling into manual unit conversion workarounds. Part of tracking issue #32093 to migrate RPC feerate representations to sat/vB, addressing rounding and truncation issues in sub-1 sat/vB environments without breaking backwards compatibility.
